name: hexkit
title: Hexkit
description: Run Hexkit developer tools from Raycast — JSON, JWT, hashing, encoders and more, with one-key fallback to the desktop app.
author: trinvh

preferences.name: hexkitCliPath
preferences.title: Hexkit CLI path
preferences.description: Path to the `hexkit` binary. Leave as `hexkit` if it's on your PATH.

preferences.name: licenseKey
preferences.title: License key
preferences.description: Hexkit Pro license key (optional today, required for Pro features in the future).

commands.name: search-tools
commands.title: Search Tools
commands.subtitle: Hexkit
commands.description: Browse every Hexkit tool and open it in Raycast or the desktop app.

commands.name: format-json
commands.title: Format JSON
commands.subtitle: Hexkit
commands.description: Format JSON from clipboard or selected text, with key sorting and JSONPath filter options.

commands.name: decode-jwt
commands.title: Decode JWT
commands.subtitle: Hexkit
commands.description: Decode a JWT from clipboard or selection and inspect its header, payload and claims.

commands.name: hash-text
commands.title: Hash Text
commands.subtitle: Hexkit
commands.description: Hash text with MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 or SHA-512.

commands.name: generate-uuid
commands.title: Generate UUID
commands.subtitle: Hexkit
commands.description: Generate a UUID v4 and copy it to the clipboard.
